interpretation.mapping_seed_note: The three mapping seeds change the mapper architecture's generated reliability map. They are not claimed to be independent circuit instances unless a partition-difference audit confirms it.
interpretation.memory_sweep_note: The 2..64 ACE communication-memory sweep changes the simulator memory-bank capacity only. It reuses this fixed data-qubit placement, so it is an EPR-resource sensitivity experiment, not a hardware-area-balanced architecture comparison.
